entries.title: Fixed Axial Plunger Carrier and Slanted Plate
entries.description: One independently authored complete fixed axial-plunger and slanted-plate mechanical exhibit. A common annular rear carrier holds six complete bored axial sleeves around one central shaft. Six full separate plunger rods extend unequal distances from the sleeve mouths and terminate against independent angled round shoe appearances facing one continuous tilted annular plate. Two complete bored shaft bearings, separate side plate supports, proud sleeve-mouth bands and a shared low grounded bed complete the assembly. The open sleeve carrier is an assembly, not a claimed single-piece pressure barrel; occupied bores do not imply a clear assembled passage. All numeric geometry new, no old piston or pump meshes imported. Unlike a single straight cylinder or radial slotted vane chamber, the whole combines a circumferential axial sleeve array with a common inclined end plane. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z-up, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin, one model zero scenes. Static artistic geometry only: no sealed volume, fluid circuit, pumping, displacement, continuous contact, shoe travel, kinematics, rotation, pressure, efficiency, force, manufacture or machinery safety claim. Rigging animation and interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Pin Ring And Perforated Eccentric Lobe Disc
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed pin-ring and eccentric lobed-disc mechanism exhibit. A common low plinth carries two roots of a full rear annular frame holding ten complete cylindrical perimeter pins. One offset-centre thick nine-lobe plate stands inside that ring; its central bore and six separate large output openings pass through the complete plate. A complete eccentric centre bushing surrounds a nominal central shaft on a separate bored rear pedestal. Behind the plate, a central hub and six full radial arms carry six smaller pins visibly through the oversized plate holes, with deliberately unequal fixed clearances. The disc has smoothly varying blunt lobes rather than integral gear teeth. All geometry is independently authored as one complete apparatus, no old planetary gears or Geneva parts imported. The topology is one perforated eccentric plate within discrete perimeter pins, not several toothed planets in a toothed annulus or a drive peg entering a slotted wheel. Four opaque constant PBR appearances, metres Z up, one model zero scenes and complete ground plinth. This is a stylized static relationship display only: the lobe curve is decorative rather than a certified cycloidal profile, and deliberate outer-pin and output-hole gaps do not establish meshing or contact. No working reducer, motion solution, tooth engagement, eccentric travel, bearing fit, gear ratio, torque transfer, lubrication, engineering accuracy, manufacture, load or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction are not made.

entries.title: Fixed Single Sided Peg and Continuous Warp Band Loom
entries.description: One newly authored complete one-sided narrow-band weaving-frame appearance. Two full crossfeet carry a low longitudinal side frame, a high rear upright, rising side arm and lower brace. Five complete cantilevered round pegs support eight continuous closed warp-appearance circuits around the entire changing-height route. Every route bends around the actual peg surface rather than ending in disconnected straight painted lines. A separate low transverse heddle bar and four whole genuinely open elongated loops occupy the front upper working span. Unlike the old horizontal four-wing warping cage, this is not an axial rotating framework with two end stands; all pegs project from one side and the thread path stays in a vertical plane. Unlike the full treadle floor loom, there are no two end drums, tall two-shaft castle, beater or treadles. No old mesh imported, extracted or scaled. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and horizontal whole-bounds-centred ground origin. One whole static prop zero scenes. Generic inkle-inspired display only, not a validated weaving system: no interlacing sequence, shed change, thread movement, tension, textile result, ergonomic suitability, adjustment, manufacture or safe operation. No rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Fixed Short Hammerbeams and High Arch Portal
entries.description: One complete newly authored fixed hammerbeam-style architectural portal. Two full grounded timber-look posts on broad stone feet carry separate short inward hammerbeams, each with a whole bent lower knee brace. Independent short upper posts connect those stubs to two complete steep principal rafters. Two high curved arch braces rise inward from the hammerbeams to a high collar and short crown upright, leaving the entire low central span without a continuous transverse tie. The open short-beam and high-arch relation differs from the old shallow hangar truss with uninterrupted lower chord and triangular webs, and from the enclosed gambrel half-loft storehouse. All member geometry newly authored, not old beams extracted or repeated web count. Three opaque constant PBR appearances, metres Z-up, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin, one complete architectural module zero scenes. Fixed artistic assembly only; no enclosing roof or building, host interchangeability, timber joinery design, structural load path, span, strength, stability, historical accuracy, manufacture, building-code compliance or construction safety claim. No rigging animation or interaction.
